title: Writing a CV
examples: Should I include my hobbies on my CV?
How long should my CV be for a first job?
What is the best way to list my school projects?

explain.say: A CV shows what you know and what you can do.

draw.text: CV: What you know and can do

explain.say: Your CV must have clear sections like contact details and education.
Use numbers to show your achievements, like improving a score.
Try to keep your entire CV to just one page long.
In real life, a CV helps you get an interview for a job.
A common mistake is writing long paragraphs about everything.

items: Focus on results, not just tasks

faq.q: How much detail should I put in my education section?
faq.a: You should list the name of the school and the dates you attended. You can also mention key qualifications you earned there.
asks: Do I list every class I took?

faq.q: Is it okay to put my hobbies on my CV?
faq.a: Only include hobbies if they show skills needed for the job, like teamwork or leadership. Otherwise, it takes up space.
asks: Should I mention my free time activities?
Are hobbies important for a CV?

faq.q: What counts as a good achievement number?
faq.a: It is good to use percentages, amounts of money, or the number of people you helped. Numbers make your claims strong.
asks: How do I prove I am good at something?

faq.q: If I have little experience, what should I write?
faq.a: Focus on school projects, volunteer work, or group assignments. These show you can work with others.
asks: What if I have no paid jobs?
Can school work count as experience?

faq.q: Can my CV be longer if I have many achievements?
faq.a: It is best to keep it to one page if you are early in your career. Recruiters often spend very little time reading.

facts: A CV is a summary of your qualifications and work history.
Achievements are strongest when backed by measurable numbers.
For students, one page is the recommended length for a CV.
Always tailor your CV to match the specific job you are applying for.

quiz.say: Which section lists your high school and college names?
quiz.why: The Education section is where you list your formal learning history.

wrong.0: Skills lists abilities, not where you learned them.
wrong.1: Contact details are just how people reach you.
wrong.2: Achievements are the results, not the place of study.

quiz.say: If you organized a fundraiser that raised one hundred dollars, how should you write it?
quiz.why: Using the dollar amount makes your achievement clear and powerful.

wrong.1: This is too vague and does not show the result.
wrong.2: This suggests you only participated, not that you achieved something.
wrong.3: This is just a description, not a measurable achievement.

quiz.say: What is the main purpose of keeping a CV to one page?

options.show: Because it is easier to read
options.say: Because it is easier to read

quiz.why: Keeping it short shows you can present information clearly and quickly.

wrong.0: The goal is to impress, not to fill space.
wrong.1: While true, the core reason is to show strong editing skills.
wrong.2: While true, the main professional reason is impact.
